faq.q: What is a titanium wheel hub pawl spring?
faq.a: A titanium wheel hub pawl spring is a precision-machined wheel hardware component used in hub ratchet pawl leaf spring (nitinol). Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium wheel hub pawl spring?
faq.a: Titanium Wheel Hub Pawl Spring is designed for hub ratchet pawl leaf spring (nitinol). The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium wheel hub pawl spring manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Wheel Hub Pawl Spring is manufactured using Wire drawing. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium wheel hub pawl spring?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
